card.name: Mixed general web text words
card.fires_on: No shared word or setting; it fires on scattered words such as 'of', 'No', 'Think', 'population' and 'cell' in general web prose.
card.plain: It responds to assorted everyday words in general web text, such as 'of', 'No', 'Think', 'population' and 'cell'. Nothing in common was found across the passages.
